rule: No source snapshot is in this repository. Before collection, re-check the publisher page, download from its official location, record access date and SHA-256, and obtain any institutional approval required.

sources.title: Online Retail
sources.citation: Chen, D. (2015). Online Retail [Dataset]. UCI Machine Learning Repository. https://doi.org/10.24432/C5BW33
sources.size_schema: 541,909 instances; 6 fields: InvoiceNo, StockCode, Description, Quantity, InvoiceDate, UnitPrice, CustomerID, Country (publisher documentation describes transactional fields; verify exact export schema)
sources.suitability: Supports transaction, cancellation, quantity, price, country and time-scope tasks; does not itself supply gross/net definitions or multiple currencies.
sources.redistribution: CC BY 4.0 attribution required; preserve citation and source notice.

sources.title: Online Shoppers Purchasing Intention Dataset
sources.citation: Sakar, C. O. & Kastro, Y. (2018). Online Shoppers Purchasing Intention Dataset [Dataset]. UCI Machine Learning Repository. https://doi.org/10.24432/C5F88Q
sources.size_schema: 12,330 sessions; 17 features plus Revenue target; numerical and categorical session, region, visitor, traffic and month fields
sources.suitability: Supports session, channel, region, visitor and revenue-label ambiguity/refusal tasks; Revenue is a Boolean outcome, not monetary sales.
sources.redistribution: CC BY 4.0 attribution required; preserve citation and source notice.

sources.title: Bank Marketing
sources.citation: Moro, S., Rita, P., & Cortez, P. (2014). Bank Marketing [Dataset]. UCI Machine Learning Repository. https://doi.org/10.24432/C5K306
sources.download: official UCI ZIP files, about 1 MB
sources.size_schema: 45,211 instances/17 fields in bank-full; bank-additional-full 41,188 instances/20 inputs; client/campaign variables and term-deposit target
sources.suitability: Supports balance/unit, campaign/contact, temporal-scope and unsupported causal-question tasks; it does not supply dashboard-ready financial statements.
sources.redistribution: CC BY 4.0 attribution required; preserve citation and source notice.

verification_method: Publisher pages checked 2026-11-04; metadata only. Files, checksums, exact selected columns, and downstream transformations remain unverified until collection.
